package Chapter8;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.DriverManager;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;

public class EX05 {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Connection conn = null;
		PreparedStatement pstmt = null;
		String driver = "oracle.jdbc.OracleDriver";
		String url = "jdbc:oracle:thin:@localhost:1521:xe";
		String dbId = "C##JAVAUSER";
		String dbPw = "java2024";
		
		try {
			String query = "UPDATE STUDENT SET DEPARTMENTCODE = ? WHERE NAME = ?";
			Class.forName(driver);
			conn = DriverManager.getConnection(url, dbId, dbPw);
			pstmt = conn.prepareStatement(query);
			pstmt.setInt(1, 222);
			pstmt.setString(2, "홍길동");
			int result = pstmt.executeUpdate();
			
			if (result == 1) {
				System.out.println("UPDATE 성공!");
			}
		} catch (Exception e) {
			System.out.println("UPDATE 실패!");
			e.printStackTrace();
		} finally {
			try {
				if (pstmt != null) pstmt.close();
				if (conn != null) pstmt.close();
			} catch (Exception e) {
				e.printStackTrace();
			}
		}
	}

}

package Chapter8;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.DriverManager;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;

public class EX06 {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Connection conn = null;
		PreparedStatement pstmt = null;
		String driver = "oracle.jdbc.OracleDriver";
		String url = "jdbc:oracle:thin:@localhost:1521:xe";
		String dbId = "C##JAVAUSER";
		String dbPw = "java2024";
		
		try {
			String query = "DELETE FROM STUDENT WHERE STUDENTID = ?";
			
			Class.forName(driver);
			conn = DriverManager.getConnection(url, dbId, dbPw);
			pstmt = conn.prepareStatement(query);
			pstmt.setInt(1, 202412);
			int result = pstmt.executeUpdate();
			
			if (result == 1) {
				System.out.println("DELETE 성공!");
			}
		} catch (Exception e) {
			System.out.println("DELETE 실패!");
		} finally {
			try {
				if (pstmt != null) pstmt.close();
				if (conn != null) conn.close();
			} catch (Exception e) {
				e.printStackTrace();
			}
		}
	}

}

package Chapter8;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.DriverManager;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class EX07 {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		// Quiz. 학번 입력 받아서 학생 정보를 조회하는 코드 작성
		Connection conn = null;
		Statement stmt = null;
		ResultSet rs = null;
		String driver = "oracle.jdbc.OracleDriver";
		String url = "jdbc:oracle:thin:@localhost:1521:xe";
		String dbId = "C##JAVAUSER";
		String dbPw = "java2024";
		
		try {
			Scanner input = new Scanner(System.in);
			System.out.print("조회할 학생의 학번 입력: ");
			int studentID = input.nextInt();
			String query = "SELECT * FROM STUDENT WHERE STUDENTID = " + studentID;
			Class.forName(driver);
			conn = DriverManager.getConnection(url, dbId, dbPw);
			stmt = conn.createStatement();
			rs = stmt.executeQuery(query);
			
			while(rs.next()) {
				studentID = rs.getInt("STUDENTID");
				String name = rs.getString("NAME");
				int age = rs.getInt("AGE");
				int grade = rs.getInt("GRADE");
				int departmentCode = rs.getInt("DEPARTMENTCODE");
				
				System.out.println(name + "학생의 학번 : " + studentID);
				System.out.println(name + "학생의 나이 : " + age + "살");
				System.out.println(name + "학생의 학년 : " + grade + "학년");
				System.out.println(name + "학생의 학과 코드 : " + departmentCode + "번");
			}
		} catch(Exception e) {
			e.printStackTrace();
		} finally {
			try {
				if(stmt != null)stmt.close();
				if(conn != null)conn.close();
			} catch (Exception e) {
				e.printStackTrace();
			}
		}
	}

}

package Chapter8;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.DriverManager;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.ResultSetMetaData;

public class EX08 {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Connection conn = null;
		PreparedStatement pstmt = null;
		ResultSet rs = null;
		String driver = "oracle.jdbc.OracleDriver";
		String url = "jdbc:oracle:thin:@localhost:1521:xe";
		String dbId = "C##JAVAUSER";
		String dbPw = "java2024";
		
		try {
			String query = "SELECT * FROM STUDENT";
			Class.forName(driver);
			conn = DriverManager.getConnection(url, dbId, dbPw);
			pstmt = conn.prepareStatement(query);
			rs = pstmt.executeQuery();
			
			ResultSetMetaData metaData = rs.getMetaData();
			int columnCount = metaData.getColumnCount();
			
			System.out.println("===== Result Set MetaData =====");
			for (int i = 1; i <= columnCount; i++) {
				System.out.println("Column " + i + ":");
				System.out.println("NAME: " + metaData.getColumnName(i));
				System.out.println("Type: " + metaData.getColumnTypeName(i));
				System.out.println("Size: " + metaData.getColumnDisplaySize(i));
				System.out.println("IS Nullabe: " + metaData.isNullable(i) );
			}
			
		} catch (Exception e) {
			e.printStackTrace();
		} finally {
			try {
				if(pstmt != null) pstmt.close();
				if(conn != null)conn.close();
			} catch (Exception e) {
				e.printStackTrace();
			}
		}
	}

}

Quiz1번 테이블 활용하여 데이터 프로그램 제작

1. 데이터 전체 조회 2. 데이터 삽입 3. 데이터 삭제 4. 데이터 수정 5. 데이터 조회 기능 제작

1. 데이터 전체 조회
2. id, password, name, age, address 입력받아 데이터 삽입
3. id 입력 받아 데이터 삭제
4. name 입력 받아 address 수정
5. name 입력 받아 데이터 조회

잘못 입력시 데이터 프로그램 종료

file
package: Chapter8
interface: DataPro.java
class : DataProImpl.java, Datamain.java  


정답
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
package Chapter8;

public interface DataPro {
	public void listData();
	public void insertData();
	public void deleteData();
	public void updateData();
	public void selectData();
}

-------------------------------------------------------------------------
package Chapter8;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.DriverManager;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class DataProImpl implements DataPro {
	Connection conn = null;
	PreparedStatement pstmt = null;
	ResultSet rs = null;
 	Scanner input = null;
	
	String driver = "oracle.jdbc.OracleDriver";
	String url = "jdbc:oracle:thin:@localhost:1521:xe";
	String dbId = "C##JAVAUSER";
	String dbPw = "java2024";

	@Override
	public void listData() {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		try {
			String query = "SELECT * FROM Quiz1";
			Class.forName(driver);
			conn = DriverManager.getConnection(url, dbId, dbPw);
			pstmt = conn.prepareStatement(query);
			rs = pstmt.executeQuery(query);
			
			while(rs.next()) {
				String id = rs.getString("ID");
				int password = rs.getInt("PASSWORD");
				String name = rs.getString("NAME");
				String age = rs.getString("AGE");
				String address = rs.getString("ADDRESS");
				
				System.out.println("ID: " + id);
				System.out.println("PASSWORD: " + password);
				System.out.println("NAME: " + name);
				System.out.println("AGE: " + age);
				System.out.println("ADDRESS: " + address);
			}
		} catch(Exception e) {
			e.printStackTrace();
		} finally {
			try {
				if(pstmt != null)pstmt.close();
				if(conn != null)conn.close();
			} catch (Exception e) {
				e.printStackTrace();
				}
			}
		}


	@Override
	public void insertData() {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		try {
			input = new Scanner(System.in); 
			System.out.print("id: ");
			String id = input.next();
			System.out.print("password: ");
			int password = input.nextInt();
			System.out.print("name: ");
			String name = input.next();
			System.out.print("age: ");
			String age = input.next();
			System.out.print("address: ");
			String address = input.next();
			
			String query = "INSERT INTO Quiz1 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";
			Class.forName(driver);
			conn = DriverManager.getConnection(url, dbId, dbPw);
			pstmt = conn.prepareStatement(query);
			pstmt.setString(1, id);
			pstmt.setInt(2, password);
			pstmt.setString(3, name);
			pstmt.setString(4, age);
			pstmt.setString(5, address);
			int result = pstmt.executeUpdate();
			if (result == 1) {
				System.out.println("INSERT 성공!");
			}
		} catch (Exception e) {
			System.out.println("INSERT 실패!");
			e.printStackTrace();
		} finally {
			try {
				if (pstmt != null) pstmt.close();
				if (conn != null) conn.close();
			} catch (Exception e) {
				e.printStackTrace();
				}
			}
		}	
	
	@Override
	public void deleteData() {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		try {
			input = new Scanner(System.in); 
			System.out.print("id: ");
			String id = input.next();
			String query = "DELETE FROM Quiz1 WHERE ID = ?";
			
			Class.forName(driver);
			conn = DriverManager.getConnection(url, dbId, dbPw);
			pstmt = conn.prepareStatement(query);
			pstmt.setString(1, id);
			
			int result = pstmt.executeUpdate();
			
			if (result == 1) {
				System.out.println("DELETE 성공!");
			}
		} catch (Exception e) {
			System.out.println("DELETE 실패!");
			e.printStackTrace();
		} finally {
			try {
				if (pstmt != null)pstmt.close();
				if (conn != null)conn.close();
			} catch (Exception e) {
				e.printStackTrace();
				}
			}
		}
	
	@Override
	public void updateData() {
		try {
			input = new Scanner(System.in); 
			System.out.print("수정할 name: ");
			String name = input.nextLine();
			System.out.print("수정할 address: ");
			String address = input.next();
			String query = "UPDATE Quiz1 SET ADDRESS = ? WHERE NAME = ?";
			Class.forName(driver);
			conn = DriverManager.getConnection(url, dbId, dbPw);
			pstmt = conn.prepareStatement(query);
			pstmt.setString(1, address);
			pstmt.setString(2, name);
			int result = pstmt.executeUpdate();
			if (result == 1) {
				System.out.println("UPDATE 성공!");
			}
		} catch (Exception e) {
			System.out.println("UPDATE실패");
			e.printStackTrace();
		} finally {
			try {
				if (pstmt != null)pstmt.close();
				if (conn != null)conn .close();
			} catch (Exception e) {
				e.printStackTrace();
				}
			}
		}
		
	
	@Override
	public void selectData() {
		try {
			input = new Scanner(System.in);
			System.out.print("name: ");
			String selectname = input.next();
			String query = "SELECT * FROM Quiz1 WHERE NAME = ?";
			Class.forName(driver);
			conn = DriverManager.getConnection(url, dbId, dbPw);
			pstmt = conn.prepareStatement(query);
			pstmt.setString(1, selectname);
			rs = pstmt.executeQuery();
			
			if (rs.next()) {
				String id = rs.getString("ID");
				int password = rs.getInt("PASSWORD");
				String name = rs.getString("NAME");
				String age = rs.getString("AGE");
				String address = rs.getString("ADDRESS");
				
				System.out.println("ID: " + id);
				System.out.println("PASSWORD: " + password);
				System.out.println("NAME: " + name);
				System.out.println("AGE: " + age);
				System.out.println("ADDRESS: " + address);
			} else {
				System.out.println("존재하지 않습니다.");
			}
			
		} catch (Exception e) {
			e.printStackTrace();
		} finally {
			try {
				if(rs != null)rs.close();
				if(pstmt != null)pstmt.close();
				if(conn != null)conn.close();
			} catch (Exception e) {
				e.printStackTrace();
				}
			}
		}
}

package Chapter8;

import java.util.Scanner;

public class Datamain {
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner input = new Scanner(System.in);
		DataPro pro = new DataProImpl();
		
		while(true) {
			System.out.println("1. 데이터 전체 조회 2. 데이터 삽입 3. 데이터 삭제 4. 데이터 수정 5. 데이터 조회");
			System.out.print("번호 입력: ");
			int select = input.nextInt();
			
			switch(select) {
			case 1: pro.listData(); break;
			case 2: pro.insertData();break;
			case 3: pro.deleteData(); break;
			case 4: pro.updateData(); break;
			case 5: pro.selectData(); break;
			default: System.out.println("잘못입력하셨습니다.");
					 input.close();
					 System.out.println("프로그램을 종료합니다.");
				 	 System.exit(0);
			}
		}
	}
}
